__desc: Japandi Dev is an anonymous developer website for practical software projects, applications, and experiments inspired by Japandi design.
__ogalt: The Japandi Dev logo beside the words Japandi Dev and the line Coding with simplicity and purpose.
__title: Japandi Dev — Coding with Simplicity and Purpose
building_digital_experiences_with: Software built for a clear purpose.
i_rsquo_m_a: I’m a software developer with an interest in simple interfaces and Japandi design. This is where I share the applications and experiments I build.
a_collection_of_applications: Applications and small experiments made to solve practical problems without unnecessary complexity.
track_your_money_not: Track your money, not your stress.
a_simple_private_finance: A free, private financial tracker for Android. Budgets can follow your payday, and your financial records stay on your phone.
view_project: Explore the free Squirio financial tracker
launching_exclusively_on_android: Launching exclusively on Android in October 2026.
i_apply_the_same: I start with the problem, build the smallest useful version, and remove anything that makes the product harder to understand or maintain.
i_keep_interfaces_and: I keep interfaces and code focused on the task at hand.
every_feature_should_solve: Every feature should solve a problem that a user can recognize.
i_balance_functionality_maintainability: I consider maintainability, performance, accessibility, and visual design together.
i_treat_every_project: I use each release to learn what should be kept, changed, or removed.
in_code_these_turn: In practice, KISS and YAGNI keep the scope small. DRY is useful when shared code reduces maintenance; unnecessary abstraction makes code harder to read. SOLID and GRASP help separate responsibilities so later changes remain manageable.
japandi_dev_is_my: Japandi Dev is my anonymous space for sharing software projects and experiments.
the_name_reflects_my: The name comes from Japandi design: Japanese restraint combined with Scandinavian warmth and function.
i_try_to_bring: I use the same idea in software by favoring clear structure, useful features, and fewer distractions.
if_you_would_like: Have feedback about a project or want to discuss a software idea? Send an email.
a_personal_space_for: An anonymous space for software projects and Japandi-inspired ideas.
squirio_home_screen_showing: Squirio home screen showing the current pay period, balance, spending guidance, wallets, recent transactions, and Squi waving.
